versions.changelog:
Initial release of CUDA Ollama fleet router.

- Route Ollama LLM inference across multiple NVIDIA CUDA GPUs with automatic load balancing.
- Supports GPU fleets including RTX 4090, 4080, 4070, 3090, A100, L40S, H100 on Linux and Windows.
- Features 7-signal scoring, vRAM-aware fallback, and CUDA auto-retry for robust routing.
- Provides cluster health monitoring, web dashboard, and OpenAI-compatible API endpoints.
- Manual control for model downloads and deletions for safety.
